Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Implement Klondike Solitaire game

Add a complete Klondike Solitaire implementation as the foundation for the
Bridge card game suite. Features include:

- Procedurally rendered cards with suits and rank symbols
- Full Klondike rules \(alternating colors, descending ranks\)
- Drag and drop card movement with valid move highlighting
- Double-click to auto-move cards to foundations
- Draw 1 or Draw 3 modes \(toggleable via settings\)
- Score tracking based on classic Windows Solitaire scoring
- Timer and move counter in HUD
- Win detection with celebration screen
- Resolution-independent scaling via LoveLibs

Game architecture designed for reusability - card system in src/cards/
can be extended for future games in the suite.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
